scope: Theorem 3.1 (Hypersurface Sobolev inequality) of the manuscript “Generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and Euclidean equality rigidity” (preprints/Generalized-Cartan-Hadamard-isoperimetry-and-Euclidean-equality-rigidity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 337 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a7310d708fef81ea), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every Lipschitz function v with compact support in Σ◦, QΣ(v) ≥ Ym (∫ Σ |v|q dσ )2/q . (3.2) The inequality also holds for the zero extension of every v ∈ H1 0 (U), where U ⋐ Σ◦ is open.
